senses.sense_definition: To occupy oneself in a relaxed, casual, or aimless manner with minor tasks or chores.

examples.text: On Sunday mornings, he likes to <w>putter</w> around the garden without any specific plan.
She spent the rainy afternoon <w>puttering</w> in the kitchen, reorganizing spice jars and baking cookies.

senses.sense_definition: To move while making a rapid, intermittent sequence of low popping or chugging sounds.

examples.text: The small fishing boat slowly <w>puttered</w> across the calm lake toward the dock.
An old moped <w>puttered</w> along the narrow street, leaving a thin trail of exhaust behind.

senses.sense_definition: A golf club designed specifically for rolling the ball gently across the green into the hole.

examples.text: He pulled his favorite <w>putter</w> from the bag and lined up his final shot carefully.
She bought a new lightweight <w>putter</w> to improve her short game on the green.

senses.sense_definition: An athlete who participates in the shot put event.

examples.text: The Olympic <w>putter</w> set a new personal record with his final throw of the evening.
Each <w>putter</w> stepped inside the throwing circle under the watchful eyes of the judges.

senses.sense_definition: A golfer who is executing a putt on the green.

examples.text: A skilled <w>putter</w> knows how to read the slope and dampness of the green before striking.
The young golfer proved to be a consistent <w>putter</w> during the final rounds of the tournament.

senses.sense_definition: A person who puts, places, or arranges something.

examples.text: He was a meticulous organizer, an obsessive <w>putter</w> of documents into neatly labeled folders.
The teacher acted as the primary <w>putter</w> of books back onto the classroom shelves.

senses.sense_definition: A worker who pushed small coal wagons through the underground passages of a mine.

examples.text: In nineteenth-century mines, a young <w>putter</w> would haul heavy carts of coal through narrow tunnels.
The museum display honors every miner and <w>putter</w> who worked in dangerous underground conditions.
